title: KB Creation Framework — Phase Contracts
description: Schema for audit-templates/phase-contracts.yaml (v3.1.12+). Declares each phase prompt's consumes/produces contract so Validate-Pipeline.ps1 can verify the framework's end-to-end DAG before model spend.

external_inputs.description: Artifact paths produced outside the framework's prompt pipeline (e.g., the operator's raw research questions, primary sources retrieved by adapters). Treated as 'always available' for consumes-check.

prompt.description: Relative path to the phase prompt file.

consumes.description: Artifact paths (relative to KB root) the phase requires as input. Validate-Pipeline.ps1 verifies each is produced by an earlier phase or listed in external_inputs.

produces.description: Artifact paths this phase writes to KB root.

rule_19_role.description: assignment: sets up Rule 19 (Phase 0.0). producer: generates content checked by a verifier. verifier: checks content from a producer (must be cross-family per Rule 19). neutral: not subject to Rule 19 (e.g., framework scripts).

rule_19_pair.description: For verifier phases: [verifier_phase_id, producer_phase_id]. Verifier's actual_family MUST differ from producer's actual_family per Rule 19.

optional.description: If true, the phase may be skipped without failing Validate-Pipeline.ps1 coverage check.

iteration.description: Loop semantics per haystack pipeline-loop pattern. If absent, phase runs once.
